```
project-root/
├── index.html                    # Entry point - glassmorphism UI overlay

├── entities/
│   ├── ObjectPool.js             # Generic object pooling for projectiles/entities
│   ├── ParticleManager.js        # Centralized particle system (500 hard cap)

├── generation/
│   ├── ProceduralTexture.js      # Canvas-based texture generation

└── vfx/
    ├── HitStop.js                # Frame-freeze / timescale dilation system
    ├── FloatingText3D.js         # Dynamic 3D score text renderer

[GameName]/                       # Individual game directory (e.g., asteroids/)
├── GameConfig.js                 # Game-specific constants and tuning
├── GameLogic.js                  # Core gameplay mechanics
├── EntityFactory.js              # Procedural entity creation (meshes, materials)

└── index.html                    # Game-specific entry point

dist/                             # Build output (generated by Vite)
node_modules/                     # Dependencies (gitignored)
```
